recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future Provenance extension navigation is needed in the Extension Pack, track it separately in that repository rather than using FHIR-8625 to restore a stale core page.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core Provenance issue reporting that the Provenance HL7 Extensions page was missing from the build; the decisive Jira comment states there were no Provenance extensions to show, so the profile/link was unlinked.
initial_application: Applied in SVN revision 6595, represented in git as 01e7faa326af0f78c4bb0b8093876928919ea4d8, which prefixed the Provenance HL7 Extensions profile name and filename with '!' in the Provenance spreadsheet source. Later source rework deleted the old provenance-extensions spreadsheet rather than restoring the old page.
additional_context: Provenance is still active in source/fhir.ini, but current core source contains no provenance-extensions page/link and no source/provenance/*extension* file. The current Provenance package/profile content is Provenance Relevant History, which is not the old empty HL7 Extensions page. The FHIR Extension Pack now has some Provenance-scoped extension definitions, but that is outside the core checkout and does not make this old core link-removal issue incomplete.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit and made no source change, because reintroducing a core Provenance HL7 Extensions page or link would reverse the applied Jira resolution and no current build-scope source defect remains.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Provenance issue saying the Provenance HL7 Extensions page was missing from the build; the Jira comment says there were none and the profile was unlinked in SVN revision 6595.
evidence_items.learned: The accepted correction was to stop exposing an empty/missing Provenance extensions page rather than add extension definitions.

evidence_items.summary: Commit '#8625 - remove provenance extensions profile because there are no extensiosn' disabled the old Provenance HL7 Extensions profile name and filename.
evidence_items.learned: This is the source application of the Jira decision and shows the old profile/link was intentionally disabled.

evidence_items.summary: Provenance is still active in the current core build, and the current Provenance package list points to ImplementationGuide/Provenance-core for the Provenance Relevant History profile.
evidence_items.learned: Current build-scope Provenance content is present, but it is a profile package rather than the old empty HL7 Extensions page.
